title: PartyRegistered payload
description: Payload for the PartyRegistered domain event. Carried inside the approved envelope (events/envelope/domain-event.schema.json), which supplies eventId, actor, correlationId, dataClassification and requirementIds.

consentGrantId.description: CONSENT-002: a party cannot be registered without a grant, so this is required in the event as well as in the request.

_note: displayName and contact are deliberately absent. Events are replayed, forwarded and retained widely; putting a person's name and phone number in every consumer's log is not defensible. Consumers that need identity should read the party under party.read, subject to the tenant check.
